item.title: Pretty setting in a beautiful area! Five acres in Virginia. $339,000
item.description: This house has such a pretty setting! It’s in a beautiful area of Virginia. They have a build date of 1940, but it is 1897. It is located on 5.39 acres in Hillsville, Virginia. The house features a covered front porch, original wood floors, nice fireplaces, pretty staircase and baseboards. There are six fireplaces and five have been sealed and are ready for gas logs. Five bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,268 square feet. $339,000 Contact Ronnie Collins with Keller Williams Realty Elite: 276-733-902

item.title: Move in ready! Nice porch! One acre in North Carolina. $275,000
item.description: This house is move in ready! Nice porch and outbuildings. The house was built in 1930. It is located on one acre in Green Mountain, North Carolina. The house features an inviting front porch, exposed brick hearth, baseboards, updated bathrooms and a spacious kitchen. There is a detached garage and a detached storage building. The home is situated in the Big Creek community. Three bedrooms, three bathrooms and 1,382 square feet. $275,000 Contact Alli Buchanan with Dream Mountain Realty From the Z

item.title: Fixer Upper Alert! On 15 acres in Virginia. $350,000
item.description: Fixer Upper Alert! Nice acreage and there is water frontage. The house was built in 1900. It is located on 15 acres in Concord, Virginia. The house features double front porches, original wood floors, baseboards and bay windows. This would be quite a project. The property is situated along Stonewall Creek. Two bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,566 square feet. $350,000 Contact Thomas Nolen with Nolen Real Estate: 434-939-2032 From the Zillow listing: 643 River Bottom Lane is a rare 15 acre riverfront

item.title: What a pretty yard! Has a guesthouse! C. 1923 in Florida. $459,900
item.description: What a pretty yard this house has! That little guesthouse could be cute! The house was built in 1923. It is located in Mt. Dora, Florida. The house features beautiful landscaping, wrought iron fencing, a sunroom, wood floors, baseboards, brick fireplace, updated kitchen and mini splits. There is a detached building that is currently used as a media room, but would make a nice guesthouse. The property is fenced and there are two detached storage sheds. item.title: Porch goals! Move in ready! Detached in-law suite. C. 1900 in Georgia. $219,900
item.description: Porch goals! What a great porch! The house is move in ready! There is a detached little structure that was used as an in-law suite. The house was built in 1900. It is located on .39 acre in Quitman, Georgia. The house features a large wrap around front porch, wood floors, baseboards, crown moulding and a spacious kitchen. There is a detached in-law suite on the property. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2,118 square feet. $219,900 Contact Andrea Huguley with Dove Realty From the Zillow listing:

item.title: Wasn’t expecting that interior! Circa 1930 in Illinois. $136,900
item.description: The interior was a bit surprising! The house was built in 1930. It is located in Jacksonville, Illinois. The house features a screened in porch, claw foot tub, wood floors, exposed beams, a nice staircase, french doors, baseboards and a lot of natural light. There is a detached garage on the property. Two bedrooms, two bathrooms and 1,424 square feet. $136,900 Contact Judy Eoff with RE/MAX Results Plus: 217-245-9613 From the Zillow listing: DUTCH COLONIAL STYLE IN METICULOUS CONDITION. SO FRESH

item.title: Pretty ceilings! Circa 1920 in Illinois. $137,000
item.description: This house has some pretty ceilings! The house was built in 1920. It is located in Collinsville, Illinois. The house features wood floors, baseboards, stained glass transom window, coffered ceiling, crown moulding, built-in bookshelves, wainscoting and an updated kitchen. The property has a large back deck and a detached garage. Three bedrooms, one bathroom and 1,452 square feet. $137,000 Contact Allison Hansen with Allison Sells Homes From the Zillow listing: Open House Sunday 12:30–2:00! This

item.title: $199,900! Look at the staircase and entryway! C. 1876 in Indiana.
item.description: How about that staircase and entryway! This is a lot of house for the money. Almost 5,000 square feet. The house was built in 1876. It is located in Fort Wayne, Indiana. The house features a covered front porch, wood floors, baseboards, pocket doors, grand staircase, beautiful fireplace, built-in window seating, paneled wainscoting and a large back porch. item.title: Alabama’s most expensive old house listing! Circa 1930. $4,900,900
item.description: Welcome to Alabama’s most expensive old house listing! Love the pool area! This was fun to look through. The house was built in 1930. It is located on .29 acre in Birmingham, Alabama. The property features a beautiful pool, pool/guesthouse and a beautiful interior. The home opens to pretty patios and outdoor living spaces. Six bedrooms, seven bathrooms and 6,408 square feet. $4,900,900 From the Zillow listing: Set on two beautifully situated lots in one of Birmingham’s most sought after neighbor

item.title: 7,000 square feet! Circa 1912 in Kansas. $285,000
item.description: This is a huge house with 7,000 square feet! There are some nice details inside! The house was built in 1912. It is located on .47 acre in Larned, Kansas. The house features an expansive front porch, balcony, leaded glass, a grand staircase, vintage light fixtures, pocket doors, exposed beams, stained glass and built-in bookshelves. There are a lot of possibilities with this house. There is a detached three car garage on the property. Six bedrooms, four bathrooms and 7,000 square feet. $285,000
